goal: Replace array columns with normalized join tables and a proper theme_relationships table. Migrate existing data. Update models, triggers, and seeds.
summary: Phase 2 complete. Database schema fully normalized: 5 sutra metadata join tables + theme_relationships table created and indexed. Data migration migrated 98 rows from array columns. Sutra model uses has_many :through associations with join-based scopes and transition setters. Theme model uses recursive CTE on theme_relationships with indexed FK joins. Tsvector trigger updated to use join table subqueries via STRING_AGG, with after_save callback handling the insert case. Seed loaders work automatically via model setters (36 sutra_themes + 21 theme_relationships rows created from seeds). All 61 specs pass, zero regressions.
stepSummaries:
1. Create migration for join tables (sutra_themes, virtues, vices, situations, emotions) and theme_relationships with indexes [verified]
  2. Populate join tables from existing array column data and theme related_theme_names arrays [verified]
  3. Update Sutra model: replace array scopes with join-based associations and scopes [verified]
  4. Update Theme model: replace array-based expand_related with recursive CTE on theme_relationships [verified]
  5. Update tsvector trigger to pull theme names via joins instead of array_to_string [verified]
  6. Update seed loaders (01_themes.rb, 02_sutras.rb) to populate normalized tables [verified]
